newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open little changed.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were seen opening little changed Thursday, in line with LME copper, which recovered quickly from an early dip, after news of a further large rise in LME warehouse copper stocks of 13,025 tonnes to 173,350 tonnes.
COMEX September copper was called to open unchanged to up 0.30 cent a pound from Wednesday's close at 103.80 cents.
COMEX copper stocks fell 998 short tons to 30,756 short tons in Wednesday's data.
But the downtrend of the past three weeks in copper prices still looks to be intact, traders said, with demand easing during the traditionally slow summer period, while stocks are rising.
The LME cash-to-three month spread fell back further early Thursday to around $157.00 a tonne.
COMEX copper prices have tumbled from 12 month highs around 120 cents a pound to a low of 101.50 cents last week, as funds liquidated long positions build during the winter and spring.
